definition.text: (1.) Greek form of Jonah (Matt. 12:39, 40, 41, etc.). (2.) The father of the apostles Peter (John 21:15-17) and Andrew; but the reading should be (also in 1:42), as in the Revised Version, “John,” instead of Jonas.

lemmas.gloss: Jonas , the name of two Israelites
Simon , the name of nine Israelites
